prompt:
Derivado por site/scripts/matriz.mjs (Playwright + canvas, conversão por luminância) a partir das 9 gravuras vetoriais site/art/peca-1..9.svg, geradas no Recraft (modelo recraftv4_1_vector, 1:1) em 23/11/2026 com estes prompts:
peca-1 (salão à meia-noite): Authentic Brazilian cordel woodcut print (xilogravura), pure black ink on pure white, no gray tones, bold hand-carved lines with gouge marks. A small neighborhood hair salon at midnight seen from the street: steel roll-up door half closed, crescent moon and stars carved in the sky, a cat asleep on the sidewalk, inside a smartphone on the counter answering by itself with three speech balloons rising (a tiny calendar, a check mark, scissors), a wall clock at midnight. Folk-art composition in the tradition of J. Borges, thick outlines, irregular carved edges, thin carved border. No text, no letters.
